changelog:
Version 8.1.0

Fixed

  • A main image that APO learned from an earlier visit is now checked again: if it is far down the page, or was copied from another site (for example a test copy of a live site), it is discarded and the page measures its main image again. This stops a wrong image being preloaded for good.
  • An image preload that points at another domain is pointed at this site when this site serves the same image, so a copied site no longer downloads its images from the original site.

Improved

  • When APO leaves an existing cache file alone, the log now says why.
  • With the site's diagnostics key, the recent APO log can be read from a browser for support, without logging in. It is never cached or indexed.
